reason: Re-opened packet.js veda 86 --verse 8.48.3: Sāyaṇa’s Sanskrit labelled 8.48.3 is this verse (apāma somam amṛtā abhūma aganma jyotiḥ; his extra verse falls later, so the numbers agree here). He turns abhūma into the optative bhavema and syāma and grounds it in Soma’s own deathlessness (yasmāt tvam amṛtaḥ atas tava pānād vayam apy amṛtāḥ syāma), and glosses jyotiḥ as dyotamānaṃ svargam: “deathlessness as hoped for from drinking one who is himself deathless” and “the light as shining heaven” are both his, nothing added. Evidence words re-found verbatim. Plain sense faithful to the day (heart v4, joints v5 and v9; the speakers have drunk); no four-word run from the key. Revision 202962 dated 2019-05-31 by the Wikisource API. verse.js ok (8.48.3 at [667,3]); entry-check ok. No school, comparison or tone issue; no Nirukta treatment of the verse.
